answer:
The solver is interFoam, set as the application in system/controlDict.
The computational domain is a box from (0, 0, 0) to (10, 1, 1), i.e. 10 m in x, 1 m in y, 1 m in z.
The mesh is a single block of 100 cells in x, 10 cells in y, and 1 cell in z.
The frontAndBack boundary is set to empty to enforce a 2D simulation.
The bottom face is a noSlip wall, the left face is a noSlip wall, the right face is a patch for outflow, and the top face is a patch for atmospheric pressure.
Gravity is (0, -9.81, 0).
The initial water column occupies 0 <= x <= 1 m and 0 <= y <= 1 m and extends the full z extent.
setFields is used to initialise alpha.water: inside the box (0 0 0) to (1 1 1) the value is 1, and everywhere else the default value is 0.
The setFieldsDict uses a single cell region of type box with the above coordinates and sets (alpha.water water 1) inside it.
The defaultFieldValues section sets (alpha.water water 0).
The blockMeshDict lists six vertices defining the corners of the 10 x 1 x 1 box, one block entry (0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7) with cell counts (100 10 1) and simpleGrading (1 1 1), and five named boundary patches plus the empty frontAndBack pair.
